title: Ducts that penetrate fire-resistance-rated assemblies without dampers.
officialText:
Ducts that penetrate fire-resis-
tance-rated assemblies and are not required by this section to have dampers shall comply with the requirements of
Sections 713.2 through 713.3.3. Ducts that penetrate horizontal assemblies not required to be contained within a shaft
and not required by this section to have dampers shall comply with the requirements of Section 713.4 through
713.4.2.2.
